rows.grounds: term of address or referent for the mind
compound describing nature as that of a fisherman

items.question: What condition was relinquished when the mind assumed a fisherman nature?
premises: The state of Brahma had been present.
At that moment an abandonment occurred.
The mind took on a fisherman nature.
items.inference: The state of Brahma was abandoned when the mind became fisherman-natured.
uncertainties: Whether citta functions as a vocative address or as part of the subject description is ambiguous.
items.plain_english: Indeed, then the state of Brahma was abandoned, O fisherman-natured mind.
